user_query: I'm a travel photographer and I'm looking for unique locations to capture breathtaking shots. Can you recommend some webcams in remote and lesser-known places? Additionally, I'd like to explore the postal unit boundaries in the United Kingdom to compare them with other countries.

TaskList.description: Search for unique webcams in remote and lesser-known locations for photography purposes.
Retrieve postal unit boundary information for the United Kingdom.
Compare postal unit boundaries of the United Kingdom with those of other selected countries.
